findings.summary: Round 2's finding that provenance changed the :latest digest on every rebuild: ci.yaml now sets provenance: false. Locally, two builds of the same context had different image IDs with provenance=true and identical ones with provenance=false (provenance.log). Not shown: buildx's docker-container driver as CI runs it, or the digest GHCR stores.

.github/workflows/ci.yaml: the new 'Decide tags' step has no automated test. I checked it only in scratch repos (decide-tags.log). Two edge cases follow from the design and are not defects. (1) A docs-only push on top makes an older run drop :latest, and the docs run's own build pushes :latest. That build keeps the same digest only if the gha cache gives identical layers. (2) .github/, README.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/ and board.toml are still in the Docker build context, so a CI-only change like a8dd3b0 reruns COPY . . and cargo build. If that rebuild isn't byte-identical, Image Updater rolls out a functionally identical image. Only the registry can show either case.

Carried, still true at 10146d4: crates/app/src/main.rs (wasm get), no test covers the expired-login path (set_redirect(Manual)). The wasm code is cfg'd out of the native tests. I saw it work only in Chromium against the stand-in edge (shots/06-expired-bar.png).
Carried: no test checks that the public router doesn't serve /metrics. Live, the public port gave 401 without a token and 404 with one (direct.log).

Carried: the native app refused by Access shows 'expected value at line 1 column 1', not that access was refused (shots/app-strip.png). There's no test for sending the CF-Access-Client-Id/Secret headers or for the one-of-two check.
Carried: deploy/values.yaml access.issuer and access.aud are still empty, so CI's deploy job (helm template) fails until the owner fills them in, as the ticket notes say.

Not exercised here, cluster only: real Cloudflare Access login, expiry and service-token policy; the tunnel; the ArgoCD sync; Image Updater's write-back and the paths-ignore; the GHCR push and the real :latest digest behaviour; the ServiceMonitor; the NetworkPolicy. Android is TRU-13. I didn't rebuild the Docker image: no image input changed since 40e5377 except ci.yaml in the build context.
